AgentCompass v0.7.2 makes a model name read the row its provider really serves, keeps what you stored on the row it meant, and fixes three texts on the tray's quota cards. It closes what v0.7.1 listed as not in that release.

- **A moved name reads the new snapshot.** Some names stay while the maker changes the dated snapshot behind them. The reference data now declares, with its source, which row a served name is (`accounts.json` `provider_names`). DeepSeek's `deepseek-v4-pro` reads `deepseek-v4-pro-0813`; `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4.1-flash` read `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`. These are defaults: they hold on any provider and with no provider known, and for a spelling with an effort, a date, `-latest` or `-preview`. DeepSeek's pages disagree with each other about `deepseek-v4-pro`; the declaration takes the current price list and the change log entry that reverses the earlier announcement, and cites them. `deepseek-v4.1-flash` is not an API name DeepSeek uses; its declaration is the maintainer's, resting on the maker's change log line that V4.1 Flash moved to the 1017 snapshot.
- **A provider's own listing is the exception.** A provider whose listing names a different dated snapshot keeps its own declaration: OpenCode's and Vivgrid's `deepseek-v4-flash` is listed as the `-0731` weights, which have no row, so that pair leaves automatic routing with the reason and still launches when you name it. A listing that only repeats the name reads the default. DeepSeek's own repository ids (`deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro`, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`) name fixed weights and keep their earlier rows. Google's `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview`, shut down on 2026-05-25, has no row on Google. Mistral's two spellings of the Ministral 3 models are one row.
- **Known cost of the default.** A host that still serves the earlier open weights under the undated name is read as the new snapshot until its listing names that snapshot or the maintainer declares it (`skills/agent-compass/calibration/README.md`).
- **What you stored is read on the row it meant.** A model's checkbox is read under the id v0.7.1 gave it. A manual score keyed by a moved name follows the name to the row it means now, and a key naming the dated row itself wins for that row; the shipped maintainer score for `deepseek-v4-pro` now applies to `deepseek-v4-pro-0813`. Temporary priorities and quick reset-priority targets reach the bundle that now runs their row. No file of yours is rewritten. Names that became one model and hold different choices leave it unchecked, and `agentcompass doctor` lists them. Derived state keyed by a bundle id (launch cooldowns, provider holds, exhaustion marks) starts fresh for the bundles whose id changed.
- **On a fleet with an OpenAI-compatible gateway account** that lists these names: `deepseek-v4-pro` reads the 0813 row; `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash` and `deepseek-flash` are one model with one checkbox, checked by default where you stored no choice (the two older names were unchecked by default as superseded).
- **Coverage.** Every gated pair the saved Cindy catalog offers is covered (399 of 399); Magpie 698 of 739 first-party pairs; launch table 176 of 176. The known-gap list falls from 23 to 15 entries. The release check fails a declaration that the saved provider listings contradict, and a community-sourced declaration that rests only on a listing repeating the name.
- **Data schema stays 8.** The published set gains one table. v0.7.1 accepts the set and ignores the table, so an install on v0.7.1 keeps its behaviour until it updates.
- **Tray quota cards.** An account outside automatic routing is titled with one wording whether or not its reading fails. A title that says a state takes the header row and the reading time goes under it instead of being cut; a long title wraps. An account whose plan has no capacity says "plan reading failed" when no tier was read and "no capacity data for this plan" when a tier was read that no plan template sizes, instead of the internal name "Mode B".

Not verified on a live account: a launch through a gateway account of a name that moved; which weights third-party hosts serve under the undated names (the declarations rest on the maker's pages and repository pages read on 2026-11-19; that the repository weights were never replaced is read from their commit titles). The local Windows Sandbox installer check was not run for this release.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.7.2/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
